<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Room for Both — Wildlife at Your Home</title>

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
<script>
  tailwind.config = {
    theme: {
      extend: {
        fontFamily: {
          sans: ['Inter', 'ui-sans-serif', 'system-ui'],
          display: ['"Plus Jakarta Sans"', 'Inter', 'sans-serif'],
        },
        colors: {
          forest: {
            950: '#0B130E',
            900: '#0E1B14',
            800: '#14241B',
            700: '#1B4332',
            600: '#215240',
            500: '#2D6A4F',
          },
          sand: {
            50: '#F8FAF8',
          },
        },
        boxShadow: {
          pill: '0 20px 45px -15px rgba(11, 19, 14, 0.35)',
        },
      },
    },
  };
</script>

<style>
  html { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  .font-display { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Inter', sans-serif; }
  [data-bm] { display: none !important; }
  html[lang="bm"] [data-en] { display: none !important; }
  html[lang="bm"] [data-bm] { display: inline !important; }
  html[lang="bm"] span[data-bm], html[lang="bm"] div[data-bm] { display: inline-block !important; }

  /* page router: only the active .page is shown */
  .page.hidden { display: none !important; }

  /* identify.html — route tabs */
  .route-panel { display: none; }
  .route-panel.active { display: block; }
  .route-tab.active { background: #0B130E; color: #fff; }
  .route-tab.active .route-tab-sub { color: #86efac; }
  .id-card { cursor: pointer; }
  .id-card.selected { border-color: #2D6A4F; background: rgba(16,185,129,0.06); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #2D6A4F inset; }
  .confirm-btn { display: none; }
  .id-card.selected .confirm-btn { display: inline-flex; }
  .id-card.selected .arrow-icon { display: none; }

  /* stop-it-coming-back.html — housing toggle */
  .housing-btn.active { background: #0B130E; color: #fff; border-color: #0B130E; }

  /* print: only the currently visible page's .print-area prints */
  @media print {
    body * { visibility: hidden; }
    .print-area, .print-area * { visibility: visible; }
    .print-area { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; box-shadow: none !important; border: 2px solid #000 !important; }
    .no-print { display: none !important; }
    header, footer { display: none !important; }
  }

  /* ===================== "Apple-ish" visual pass ===================== */

  /* softer, floating shadow in place of a hairline border on elevated cards */
  .shadow-slate-900\/5 { box-shadow: 0 30px 80px -30px rgba(15,23,42,0.12) !important; }

  /* primary CTAs: gradient glow instead of a flat fill */
  .bg-emerald-600 {
    background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, #34d399 0%, #10b981 45%, #0d9488 100%) !important;
    background-color: transparent !important;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 40px -12px rgba(16,185,129,0.45);
  }
  .bg-emerald-600:hover, a.bg-emerald-600:hover {
    background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, #6ee7b7 0%, #34d399 45%, #10b981 100%) !important;
  }
  .bg-emerald-500 {
    background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, #6ee7b7 0%, #34d399 50%, #10b981 100%) !important;
    background-color: transparent !important;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 40px -12px rgba(16,185,129,0.4);
  }
  .bg-emerald-500:hover, a.bg-emerald-500:hover {
    background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, #a7f3d0 0%, #6ee7b7 50%, #34d399 100%) !important;
  }

  /* scroll-triggered fade + rise, Apple product-page style */
  .reveal {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(28px);
    transition: opacity 0.8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
    will-change: opacity, transform;
  }
  .reveal.in-view { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .reveal { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; transition: none !important; }
  }

  /* dark hero panels get a real (openly-licensed) photo instead of a flat
     near-black fill — a soft scrim on top keeps white text fully legible */
  .hero-photo {
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center 38%;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
  }
  /* home hero background carousel — 3 openly-licensed photos (sun bear,
     tapir, hornbill), distinct from the macaque/forest photos used on every
     other page, cross-fading between them on a timer. Each slide is a
     full-bleed layer stacked under the same dark scrim + content; only
     .active is visible at any time. */
  .hero-carousel-slide {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center 30%;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 1.4s ease;
    z-index: 0;
  }
  .hero-carousel-slide.active { opacity: 1; }
  .hero-carousel-scrim {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,19,14,0.86) 0%, rgba(11,19,14,0.72) 45%, rgba(11,19,14,0.94) 100%);
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .hero-photo--forest {
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,19,14,0.88) 0%, rgba(11,19,14,0.76) 50%, rgba(18,28,22,0.95) 100%),
      url('https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Taman_Negara%2C_Malaysia%2C_Primary_tropical_rainforest.jpg?width=1600');
  }
  .photo-credit {
    position: absolute;
    right: 1.5rem;
    bottom: 3.25rem;
    left: 1.5rem;
    max-width: calc(100% - 3rem);
    text-align: right;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: .02em;
    color: rgba(226,232,240,0.45);
    z-index: 5;
  }
  /* the home hero has its own curved wave divider (up to ~112px tall at its
     peak) instead of the plain -mt-10 card overlap the other 9 hero photos
     use, so its credit needs a lot more clearance to sit fully in the clear
     dark area above the curve rather than partway through it. */
  .photo-credit--home {
    bottom: 8rem;
  }
  .photo-credit a { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
</style>
</head>
<body class="bg-sand-50 text-forest-950 antialiased">

<!-- =========================== NAVBAR (shared across all pages) =========================== -->
<header class="fixed top-0 inset-x-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-forest-950/70 border-b border-white/10 no-print">
  <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 h-16 flex items-center justify-between">
    <a href="#" onclick="goTo('home');return false;" class="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-white font-display font-bold tracking-tight">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64,
